clustering_commitments.candidate_independence_rule: candidate clusters from the same fit are not independent statistical tests
clustering_commitments.k_selection_rule: k=1 is always a valid null; no k is privileged (never fixed toward any particular cluster count)
clustering_commitments.model_selection_rule: no single metric decides -- every metric is computed and reported side by side
clustering_commitments.standardization_rule: training-only standardization -- no test-fold statistic ever informs a fitted scaler

compute_budget_decisions.standing_policy: every future Work Package states its own scope decision (preferred vs. hard-minimum vs. a further disclosed reduction) in its own script/report at the time it runs, matched against this manifest's already-frozen preferred/hard-minimum arithmetic -- a reduction below hard minimum is a stop condition (see STOP_CONDITIONS), not a silent adjustment
compute_budget_decisions.work_package_e_joint_discovery: ran the full PREFERRED design (576 runs), no reduction required
compute_budget_decisions.work_package_g_temporal_representation: validated the full Section 12 feature pipeline on a disclosed 12-seed-run subset of Work Package E's own frozen design (3 points x 2 seeds x 2 IC families), rather than collecting per-step phenotype snapshots for the full 576-run pool -- recorded in that script's own report['scope'] field, not left implicit; see dev_mem/status_update.md's Work Package G entry for the full disclosure

confirmation_rules.null_replication_rule: if Section 16 discovery supports no candidates, confirmation replicates the null result rather than manufacturing a candidate to test
confirmation_rules.seed_disjointness_rule: every confirmation seed must be disjoint from every Work Package E discovery seed -- fresh seeds only, never reused

feasibility_ratio_definitions.expected_pressure_ratio: Section 6.2: ``ρ_expected = expected sustainable supply / expected aggregate requested demand``, using preregistered neutral expectations (never realized simulation outcomes, never any governance/cluster/SEM label).
feasibility_ratio_definitions.monte_carlo_expected_h_m: Section 6.2's dedicated observer-only Monte Carlo cross-check for :func:`_expected_h_m`'s closed-form approximation. Draws ``n_samples`` independent ``(extraction_propensity, maintenance_propensity, scarcity_sensitivity)`` triples from exactly the same clipped-Normal distributions ``sample_ecological_policy``/``decide_ecological_action`` use, via a RNG stream that is dedicated to this observer function and is never part of ``core/rng.py``'s ``STREAM_REGISTRY`` and never reused by, or reproduced from, the simulation itself.  Returns a dict with keys ``h_mean``, ``h_std``, ``m_mean``, ``m_std``, ``n_samples`` — for comparison against the closed-form :func:`_expected_h_m` values as part of Section 6.2's required sensitivity analysis (see ``level1.2b_feasibility_method.md``).
feasibility_ratio_definitions.structural_feasibility_ratio: Section 6.1: ``ρ_struct = max sustainable exogenous supply / minimum mandatory burden``.

C.aggregation_path: Delegate objects (event: appointment) -> single call-level mean
C.name: realized_administrative_capacity
C.numerator: sum of Delegate.capacity across delegates that are currently active AND whose start_step falls in window
C.structural_missingness: NaN (not 0.0) when there are zero active delegates in range -- a real absence, not a computable zero
C.valid_window: partial -- filters by delegate start_step (an appointment-event timestamp), but conjoined with the current-tense 'active' flag, not tenure-overlaps-window

D.aggregation_path: Delegate.task_attempts (running per-delegate counter) grouped by coordination-jurisdiction root (internal only) -> single call-level mean share
D.denominator: count of jurisdictions with nonzero total activity
D.name: concentration_of_delegated_authority
D.numerator: sum, across coordination jurisdictions, of the most-active delegate's task-attempt share
D.structural_missingness: NaN when every jurisdiction has zero total activity (no share is computable)
D.valid_window: none -- window accepted for API uniformity only, has no effect (delegate.task_attempts is an unwindowed running counter)

E.name: effective_constraint_dimension
E.structural_missingness: NaN when there is no actual-misconduct-audited denominator in window (detection rate undefined, not zero)
E.valid_window: full -- delegates entirely to accountability_diagnostics.effective_constraint, which filters every underlying event list (audits/recalls/appeals/appropriations) by step_range

F.denominator: sum of active rules' age, computed as current_step - founding_step (current_step is an explicit parameter, NOT derived from window)
F.known_limitation: Section 6's 'functional recovery' half of F is intentionally NOT included here -- reported separately once Stage 7/Section 12's shock-timing context exists
F.name: amendment_flexibility
F.numerator: sum of active rules' amendment_count (lifetime running total, never reset)
F.structural_missingness: NaN when there is no active rule (denominator zero)
F.valid_window: none -- window accepted for API uniformity only, has no effect; age uses current_step even when window is also supplied and ends elsewhere

H.aggregation_path: InstitutionRecord.components (current, non-extinct only) -> pairwise distances -> single call-level mean
H.name: within_community_heterogeneity
H.numerator: sum of pairwise structural_distance across currently-non-extinct institutions' component bundles
H.structural_missingness: NaN when fewer than two non-extinct institutions exist (heterogeneity undefined for 0 or 1 institution, not zero)
H.valid_window: none -- window accepted for API uniformity only, has no effect

L.aggregation_path: SharedRule + ResourcePatch objects (current state) -> single call-level ratio
L.denominator: sum of eligible patch population for those same rules' patches (current)
L.known_limitation: institution_imposed_mode runs read as maximal support by construction (members never had a join decision) -- disclosed in institutional_phenotype.py, not treated as a bug
L.name: legitimacy_voluntary_support
L.structural_missingness: 0/0 -> NaN when there is no active rule and no eligible population at all
L.valid_window: none -- window accepted for API uniformity only, has no effect

M.aggregation_path: SharedRule.institutional_memory (running scalar, no per-step record) -> single call-level mean
M.name: institutional_memory_continuity
M.numerator: sum of active rules' institutional_memory scalar (current)
M.structural_missingness: NaN when there is no active rule
M.valid_window: none -- window accepted for API uniformity only, has no effect

R.aggregation_path: AdministrativeSpendingEvent + AppropriationEvent (event-level, windowed) over PatchSystem.total_resources (current stock) -> single call-level ratio
R.known_limitation: misuse risk if patch_system does not reflect window's end -- see institutional_phenotype.py docstring
R.name: administrative_appropriation_burden
R.numerator: administrative spending + appropriated funds, summed over events with step in window
R.structural_missingness: NaN when patch_system is None or total_resources is exactly 0
R.valid_window: partial -- numerator windowed, denominator is an unwindowed current-state stock

S.aggregation_path: coordination_components (current network topology) -> single call-level ratio
S.name: institutional_scale_reach
S.structural_missingness: 0.0 (not NaN) when there is no coordination network at all -- a well-defined absence, per Section 6
S.valid_window: none -- window accepted for API uniformity only, has no effect

V.aggregation_path: InstitutionRecord.active_jurisdiction + ResourcePatch.fraction_of_capacity (current) and SharedRule.n_members (current) -> two call-level ratios averaged into one composite value
V.name: ecological_demographic_viability
V.structural_missingness: each sub-part independently NaN under its own zero-denominator condition; the composite value is the mean of whichever sub-parts are defined (NaN only if both are)

demographic.denominator: initial_population (fixed at run start, a parameter not a live read)

ecological.numerator: sum of fraction_of_capacity across patches occupied by surviving institutions' active jurisdictions (current)

V.valid_window: none -- window accepted for API uniformity only, has no effect on either sub-part

firewall: no SEM/dissertation data, labels, or trajectory counts are read anywhere in this milestone's generative, observer, or experimental code (Section 3/21)

missing_data_rules.strategy_fitting_rule: every strategy is fit-on-train-only, never leaking test-fold statistics into imputation
missing_data_rules.structural_nan_discipline: every phenotype dimension preserves NaN for a genuine zero-denominator absence -- never zero-filled (see feature_dictionary's own structural_missingness field per dimension)

component_homology_vs_analogy.definition: biology-inspired reframing of inherited/convergent: homology=shared-origin similarity (within-run lineage sharing OR cross-run direct transmission), analogy=independently-arisen similarity (the convergent label)
distinguishes_from: no new computation -- an interpretation layer over the other three levels, recorded explicitly so it is never reinvented ad hoc

cross_run_structural_similarity.definition: members from different seed-runs land in the same discovered cluster -- a purely descriptive, pre-causal observation
distinguishes_from: independent_convergence: this level makes no claim about WHY members are similar, only that they are

independent_convergence.definition: cross-run structural similarity that is ALSO lineage-diverse beyond chance, not majority transmission-linked, and recurs across more than one parameter condition
distinguishes_from: within_run_lineage: requires cross-run evidence, never satisfied by one run alone

within_run_lineage.definition: shared ancestry between institutions in the SAME seed-run
distinguishes_from: cross_run_structural_similarity: different seed-runs, so this level never applies across runs

scale_robustness_grid.note: Section 18 explicitly does not require scale invariance -- a candidate whose behavior changes with scale is a reported finding, not a disqualification

stop_conditions: a frozen design/spec/manifest is never edited after its own hash was computed; every stage script that consumes one calls that artifact's own load_and_verify_* function, which raises rather than warns on mismatch
Section 5.7's ledger-closure gate: no feasibility mapping or discovery proceeds on any run whose ecological ledger residual is not within documented floating-point tolerance

a Work Package's hard-minimum sample size is a floor, not a target -- a run count below hard minimum is a hard stop for that Work Package's own completion claim, never silently accepted as 'close enough'
clustering results (Section 9.3/16) never determine burn-in fraction, missingness strategy, or feature selection after the fact -- those are fixed before any candidate cluster is examined
no generative object anywhere in 1.2b code is named after governance-phenotype/trajectory/SEM-adjacent terms (the SEM firewall, extended to every new module this milestone adds)

a disclosed scope reduction (e.g. Work Package G's 12-seed-run pipeline validation subset) is recorded in the reducing script's own output at the time of the reduction, never adjusted afterward to match results
